'''HiSec Facilities Access''' was a roadway on the southern side of the [[Minimum Security Section]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] that led to the industrial facilities in the [[High Security Section]]'s southern area. [[Vault K-66]] was located along the roadway, and the eastern end of the road joined the [[Primary Thoroughfare]].
